source_text: וְֽ/אֶת הַ/צְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵ/עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/הִדַּחְתִּי/ו֮ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּ/שְׁמָמָה֒ אֶת פָּנָ֗י/ו אֶל הַ/יָּם֙ הַ/קַּדְמֹנִ֔י וְ/סֹפ֖/וֹ אֶל הַ/יָּ֣ם הָ/אַֽחֲר֑וֹן וְ/עָלָ֣ה בָאְשׁ֗/וֹ וְ/תַ֨עַל֙ צַחֲנָת֔/וֹ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת־־־־־׃
english_snapshot: And I will remove the northerner far from you[a], and I will drive him into a dry and desolate land, his front into the eastern sea and his rear into the western sea; his stench will rise, and his foul smell will rise[c][b], because he has done great things.

signals.text: 'The eastern sea' likely refers to the Dead Sea, and 'the western sea' to the Mediterranean Sea.
